name: Legal Aid at Work
description: Free employment law help including discrimination, wage theft, wrongful termination, and workplace rights
fullDescription: Legal Aid at Work provides free legal services and resources to workers facing employment problems, including discrimination, wage theft, and wrongful termination.
whatTheyOffer:
- Workers' Rights Clinic (free, confidential information in Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, and other languages)
- Helplines for work and family issues, language rights, racial economic justice, and survivors of domestic violence (Project SURVIVE)
- Help with discrimination and harassment claims
- Wage theft, health and safety, and paid leave issues
- Disability and pregnancy accommodation
- 100+ free fact sheets and Know Your Rights resources
howToGetIt:
1. Call the general line at 415-864-8848 (toll-free 866-864-8208) if you're not sure which helpline fits
2. Or use the Clinics and Helplines page to call a specific helpline
3. Services are for low-income California workers
4. Complete intake to determine eligibility
5. Receive legal advice, referrals, or representation
address: 180 Montgomery Street, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94104
keywords: Legal Aid at Work, employment law, workplace rights, discrimination, harassment, wage theft, wrongful termination, disability accommodation, pregnancy, workers rights, free legal
